name: mirage
text: Done on the GitHub side: the engine's repeat guard is now 2 bets or $3 per side, and it's live already (it was $100). Your phone adopts it when you next open the app. One thing to know: a side's first order can still be bigger than $3. The cap blocks adding more once something is held. Different odds on the same side do count as the same bet, because the guard matches on the side itself, not the price, so that isn't why these got through. The new default ($3) and a $3 chip in Settings will ship in the next release. I'm still finding where the extra orders on those two games came from, because a lower cap won't help if they bypass the guard.
